notes.notes:
*Added the function to abandon a match during an online match.

*Fixed a bug that "Copy" sometimes doesn't copy "Distortion" correctly.

New deck "Special" is now available!
This will be the last deck to be added.

notes.title: V1.6.3: Mini Update
notes.notes:
*Added Full Screen mode.
*Fixed a bug that "Mysterious Ruin" sometimes did not trigger even if it fulfill the conditions.

notes.title: V1.6.2: Mini Update
notes.notes: Changed the activation condition for the field "Heavy Storm" from "at the end of the turn" to "after the player passes their turn".

notes.title: V1.6.1: Mini Update

New deck "Explorer" is added.
Enjoy the new system "field" and "Choose one"!

notes.title: V1.5.2: Mini Update
notes.notes:
*Added specification "When all players have the maximum number of cards in their hands, they can play their card regardless of the shape of the cards.
*Fixed some texts.
*Fixed that rooms with 0 players are not displayed in the lobby.

notes.title: V1.5.1: Mini update
notes.notes:
*Fixed a bug that the game did not launch correctly on Mac (with M1 or M2 chip).
*Fixed a bug that "Trash" didn't transform into "Treasure" when it passed by effect of "Wormhole".
*Removed the specification "When the hand has the maximum number of cards, the player can play the hand regardless of the shape of the cards."

notes.title: V1.5.0: Custom deck is added!
notes.notes:
*Added custom deck
*Fixed the bug that game freezes when use "Copy" to "Was Best Card" or "Was Trident Card" or "Just A Card?".

*Fixed other minor bubs.
